def snap(tag):
    f=current_frame
    pl=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:

            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            blocks[n['color']]=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
    print(tag,"player",pl,blocks)
snap("before RIGHT")
action(['RIGHT'])
snap("after RIGHT1")
action(['RIGHT'])
snap("after RIGHT2")
